_comment: UI-NFR-003 R-013/R-014/R-015/R-028 gzip budgets. Values are set just above the measured baseline so the gate starts green but fails on regression. Measured initial JS = 495.4 KB gzip on 2026-07-12 (was 471.8 KB on 2026-07-11); the ~23.6 KB growth is the eagerly-loaded i18n translation bundle absorbing three feature merges with mandatory glossary/enum copy (REQ-016 InvenTree, the glossary-terms feature, REQ-017 propagation & lineage). The dominant cost remains the eager i18n bundle (~160 KB gzip). The R-013 aspirational target is 300 KB gzip; reaching it requires lazy-loading translations (tracked separately) — this gate locks the current baseline against silent growth in the meantime.
